summary: Markets are showing a fragile relief rally rather than a confirmed trend reversal: equities and commodities rebounded, while Bitcoin remains volatile around a key $60,000 floor.[1][3][6] Crypto sentiment is cautiously bullish into month-end, but the broader altcoin market remains damaged and vulnerable to another correction.[1][4]
